title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Rises 2.8% as Chip Stocks Rebound (Nov 6)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) closed at $186.64 on Nov 6, up 2.78%, as chip stocks recovered from Thursday's selloff. After the close, its board opened a probe.
body_markdown:
The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.86%, up 2.2 basis points. Even after Friday's gain, Nvidia closed 23.31% below its 52-week high and 13.62% above its 52-week low.


## Why Nvidia Stock Rose


Financial media did not tie Friday's gain to news from Nvidia itself. Per[Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/stocks-11-6-2026) , gains in technology were broadly shared as chip stocks recovered from a Thursday selloff that came as investors weighed what[Democrats' sweeping midterm election victories](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/democratic-midterm-sweep-fallout-trump-blames-democrats-data-center-and-spacex-pushback/) could mean for AI regulation.


As reported by[Reuters](https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/international/4002927-us-stocks-nasdaq-rebounds-as-chip-stocks-recover-from-steep-losses) , the rebound followed[Nvidia's worst day since January 2025](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-6-2026/) on Thursday, a selloff tied to the Democrats' midterm victory, including in key data-center states, and to fears that a Democrat-led Congress could bring tougher AI regulation.


The session also brought a strong October jobs report. Fox Business said payrolls rose by 165,000, well above the 65,000 economists expected, and Reuters reported that traders raised their bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike in December, putting the odds at 78% during the session.


In a[statement on November 8](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors) , Nvidia's board said it is initiating an independent investigation into recent reports that founder and CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, overseen by a committee of independent directors assisted by outside independent counsel. The board said it has confidence in Huang and his leadership team.


In a[message to employees](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/a-message-to-our-company) the same day, Huang apologized to his family and colleagues, and said he supports the investigation and will cooperate fully. Because both announcements came after Friday's close, they are not part of the session's move.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Chip stocks recovered broadly on Friday after Thursday's selloff, per Fox Business, with AMD, Intel and Micron all closing higher.
- Nvidia finished 1.69 percentage points ahead of the Nasdaq Composite on volume 60.09% above its average.
- According to Nvidia, the board has confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and independent directors with outside counsel are running the investigation.


### Risks


- The board's investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort began after Friday's close, so the session's price does not reflect it.
- Reuters tied Thursday's selloff to fears that a Democrat-led Congress could bring tougher AI regulation, including in key data-center states.
- The strong jobs report lifted bets on a December rate hike, per Reuters, and the 10-year Treasury yield rose 2.2 basis points to 4.86%.


Next on the calendar, Nvidia will release its[third-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, according to the[company's announcement](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873) .
